Points to the head in an instruction bundle (and always to this for single instructions).
Single linked list of all instructions in a bundle.

briefdescription.para: Single linked list of all memory instructions (e.g.

detaileddescription.para: load, store, call) in the block - until the end of the scheduling region.

briefdescription.para: The dependent memory instructions.

detaileddescription.para: This list is derived on demand in calculateDependencies().

briefdescription.para: List of instructions which this instruction could be control dependent on.

detaileddescription.para: Allowing such nodes to be scheduled below this one could introduce a runtime fault which didn't exist in the original program. ex: this is a load or udiv following a readonly call which inf loops

briefdescription.para: This ScheduleData is in the current scheduling region if this matches the current SchedulingRegionID of BlockScheduling.
Used for getting a "good" final ordering of instructions.
The number of dependencies.

detaileddescription.para: Constitutes of the number of users of the instruction plus the number of dependent memory instructions (if any). This value is calculated on demand. If InvalidDeps, the number of dependencies is not calculated yet.

briefdescription.para: The number of dependencies minus the number of dependencies of scheduled instructions.

detaileddescription.para: As soon as this is zero, the instruction/bundle gets ready for scheduling. Note that this is negative as long as Dependencies is not calculated.

briefdescription.para: True if this instruction is scheduled (or considered as scheduled in the dry-run).
Verify basic self consistency properties.
Returns true if the dependency information has been calculated.

detaileddescription.para: Note that depenendency validity can vary between instructions within a single bundle.

briefdescription.para: Returns true for single instructions and for bundle representatives (= the head of a bundle).
Returns true if it represents an instruction bundle and not only a single instruction.
Returns true if it is ready for scheduling, i.e.

detaileddescription.para: it has no more unscheduled depending instructions/bundles.

briefdescription.para: Modifies the number of unscheduled dependencies for this instruction, and returns the number of remaining dependencies for the containing bundle.
Sets the number of unscheduled dependencies to the number of dependencies.
Clears all dependency information.
Contains all scheduling relevant data for an instruction.

detaileddescription.para: A ScheduleData either represents a single instruction or a member of an instruction bundle (= a group of instructions which is combined into a vector instruction).
